About the Fellowship

The Syed Babar Ali Fellowship supports research through Harvard's South Asia Institute. This is a research appointment rather than a doctoral admission scholarship, with financial support set for a twelve-month appointment and prorated for shorter terms.

Research Areas

  • South Asia studies
  • Interdisciplinary research
  • Research fellowship
